description: Compatibility alias for existing clients; new integrations should use buy_service. Use only after selecting one offer when the calling agent has explicit delegated authority for that exact fixed fee. Creates the governed purchase intent and quote, then returns adaptive Stripe-hosted checkout by default. It does not itself claim payment or start work.

bounded_scope_confirmed.description: True only when the buyer controls the inputs and this sanitized request is non-production and contains no secrets.

buyer_contact_email.description: Email for the authorized purchasing contact and order communications.

buyer_organization.description: Legal or operating name of the buying organization.

delegated_purchase_authority_confirmed.description: True only when the agent is acting within explicit delegated authority for this exact offer and published amount.

offer_id.description: Exact published offer ID returned by find_service or list_offers.

task_summary.description: Sanitized, bounded task summary. Never include credentials, tokens, payment data, personal data, confidential files, or production secrets.

terms_accepted.description: True only when the authorized buyer has accepted Zinvyl terms version 2026-10-23.4.

name: create_purchase_intent
title: Create an authorized purchase intent
